group_results.reason: A PNG with an accepted IHDR followed by a zero-length eXIf chunk reaches the added check when spng_get_plte reads the remaining chunks. The default non-strict decoder discards that ancillary error and continues. The target permits the required bytes and format suffix.

build.reason: The supplied recipe compiles the changed library source and read target, enables the target's file-stream branch, and links the built zlib library. The Dockerfile supplies the external build inputs referenced by the recipe.

input.reason: The entry reserves four control bytes and passes the remaining generated bytes as PNG data through supported buffer, callback, or file routes.

lifecycle.reason: The entry creates one decoder context and frees it on its normal error and completion path; the new zero-length check allocates no eXIf data before returning, and context cleanup handles stored data.

control_flow.reason: Image-size calculation reads only IHDR; the subsequent palette getter requests full chunk parsing. That parser recognizes eXIf before IDAT, executes the changed check, and its non-strict caller handles the ancillary error.
